summary: Carter County lookout at 4,094 ft, listed as removed. A 2025 Forest Service project replaced a communications tower on White Rocks mountain; no source ties it to the lookout.

facts.status_note: Both lookout pages list the tower as removed; neither gives a removal date.

events.note: Forest Service decision signed 2025-02-28 to take down an existing communications tower and build a new one on White Rocks mountain; project marked completed. Not confirmed to be the lookout site.

evidence.supports: page marks the tower as removed
project authorizes decommissioning an existing communications tower and a new tower on White Rocks mountain, Carter County
evidence.quote: The purpose of this project is to authorize the decommissioning of an existing communications tower and the construction of a new tower and associated improvements on White Rocks mountain in Carter County, TN.

evidence.supports: location: White Rocks mountain on the Watauga Ranger District, Carter County
evidence.quote: White Rocks mountain on the Watauga Ranger District in Carter County, Tennessee.

sources.title: TN lookout tower: CTT004 White Rock
White Rocks Tower Reconstruction Project
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Cherokee National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service project names White Rocks mountain in Carter County, and the tnlandforms waypoint is in Carter County at 36.23899, -82.1212. The sources do not say the lookout and the communications tower share a site, so the story does not link them.

notes_for_editor: Gone tower. No source read gives a build year, design, staffing, access rule or removal date. The Forest Service page is a project summary; the project documents (Pinyon Public / Box) were not reachable, so the old lookout's position relative to the new tower is unknown. Do not merge with the Great Smoky Mountains 'White Rock Lookout Tower' on Mount Cammerer (Cocke County), a separate standing tower that appeared only in search snippets and was not fetched or cited. The tnlandforms code 'cnf' is not explained on the page. Brief record checked: elevation 1247.9 m matches 4094 ft; agency matches; status 'gone' matches. No corrections. Search budget: 2 WebSearch calls used.
